_meta.purpose: Do-not-draft / bust consensus. NOT a ban list — a DISCOUNT trigger. These are bad VALUE at current ADP (injury, workload, role, or unsustainable 2025), but the manager will gamble when a player slides far enough past ADP that reward beats risk. See draft_strategy.md rule 4 for the price thresholds by risk type.
_meta.espn_note: ESPN entries are Eric Karabell's 'Do Not Draft' list (confirmed names only; full list is longer). Others labeled by source.
_meta.stat_line: Real 2025 regular-season actuals from nflverse — NOT a projection.

avoid.name: Christian McCaffrey
avoid.reason: 400+ touches and 900+ snaps in 2025; RBs historically don't repeat after 400-carry seasons, plus a long injury history.

avoid.name: Malik Nabers
avoid.reason: ACL + meniscus tear in Week 4 2025 that needed a follow-up procedure; Week 1 availability uncertain.

avoid.name: Cam Skattebo
avoid.reason: Reckless style = injury risk; likely a committee with Tracy/Singletary/Harris; ADP too rich for that role.

avoid.name: Jaxson Dart
avoid.reason: Young Giants trio barely shared the field in 2025; availability and consistency unproven at his cost.

avoid.name: De'Von Achane
avoid.reason: Loses McDaniel's RB-centric scheme; Miami offense looks shakier, threatening his volume.

avoid.name: Jerry Jeudy
avoid.reason: Finished WR51 in 2025 with poor yards-per-route and points below expectation; Browns drafted two WRs early under new staff.

avoid.name: Matthew Stafford
avoid.reason: 46 pass TDs on a 7.7% TD rate is historically unsustainable; no rushing to fall back on if TDs regress.

avoid.name: Bhayshul Tuten
avoid.reason: ADP climbed into the top ~60 on breakout hype, but his role is uncertain and he's shown little as a pass-catcher.

avoid.name: Jeremiyah Love
avoid.reason: Rookie hype outrunning reality: preseason high-ankle sprain, Allgeier starting Week 1, backfield crowded with Conner/Benson.
